<p>I am a postdoctoral researcher at Boston Children's Hospital and Massachusetts General Hospital, advised by Dan Bauer, Luca Pinello, and Danilo Pellin. I obtained my PhD in Statistics at Carnegie Mellon University. I work in statistical genomics, with a focus on problems arising in CRISPR genome engineering applications.</p>

 I am on the faculty job market in fall 2026. <p><a href="mailto:timothy.barry@childrens.harvard.edu">timothy.barry@childrens.harvard.edu</a>, <a href="ResumeCv/cv.pdf">CV</a>, <a href="https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Jrjax-AAAAAJ&hl=en">Scholar</a></p>
